source: Real Gulf response staging bases: USCG units (positions from OpenStreetMap facility footprints, cross-checked with the US Census Geocoder where an address exists), MSRC equipment sites (MSRC Equipment Site Map), Clean Gulf Associates bases and Texas GLO oil-spill warehouses (GLO 'Prestaged Equipment and Staging Areas'). Compiled 2026-11-22 for OilFlood T21; each entry cites its own src + coord_src.
note: Planning context only. Several units are offices inland (see each 'note'); travel times use straight-line distance x 1.3 at 30 km/h. Not a list of available equipment.
